fact: The ORAL project, led by Iscte with the University of Cabo Verde and co-funded by the OEI with USD 72,000 from 15 October 2025, is to release open-access Kriolu corpora, a first Kriolu large language model, speech recognition and public APIs on Hugging Face.
title: Iscte lança projeto internacional para o desenvolvimento de modelos de linguagem em crioulo cabo-verdiano
